eas_text: A civil authority has issued A MISSING AND ENDANGERED PERSON ALERT for the following counties or areas: Boulder, CO; at 4:53 AM on AUG 10, 2026 Effective until 6:53 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: At 05:52:53 on 08-10-2026 the Boulder County Sherriff is requesting the public's assistance in locating a missing At-risk Adult. Jane Jambill 67 year old white female, 4 foot 5 inches, approximately 100 pounds, long brown hair, possibly wearing a grey shirt and may not be wearing shoes, last known to be in the area of 151 Sky Trail Rd in the Boulder Heights Community. If found, call 911.
